# Harbor

The CRM your sales team actually updates

Harbor fills itself from email and calendar, so pipeline reviews stop being a data-entry meeting.

## Features

### Self-updating pipeline

Deals move when the emails say they moved.

### Forecast you can defend

Every number links to the evidence.

### Two-minute setup

Connect a mailbox and you are done.

## Who it is for

Sales leaders.

## Pricing

Starts free. Team plans from $29 per month.
